title: PaymentCredit - Data API
description: Tracks the amount of money returned to the customer. The return can be a store credit, a gift card, or another type of credit. It's linked to the original payment record and includes the total credit amount issued. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: The account of the customer who made the payment. This field is a relationship field. This is a required field.

Amount.description: The amount to be credited. This is a required field.

Balance.description: Balance of payment credits (NetApplied - TotalCredit TransactionAmount - TotalCredit PendingTransactionAmount).

Comments.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Comments.description: Provide additional details about the payment credit transaction.

CreditMemoId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CreditMemoId.description: ID of the credit memo associated with the payment credit. This field is a relationship field.

CreditType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CreditType.description: Credit types available. This is a dynamic picklist that the user can define. Possible values are: Credit Gift Card Gift Certificate

CreditTypeCategory.description: A static enum showing the credit category type. Possible value is: Credit

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization. Possible values are: EUR—Euro GBP—British Pound USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

EffectiveDate.description: Effective date of the payment credit.

LastReferencedDate.description: Timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: Timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

NetApplied.description: Total of all credit amounts apllied for this payment credit (TotalCreditApplied - TotalCreditUnapplied).

OrderPaymentSummaryId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
OrderPaymentSummaryId.description: ID of the order payment summary. This field is a relationship field.

PaymentCreditNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
PaymentCreditNumber.description: ID of the payment credit record. This field is automatically generated. Example: PC-{000000000}.

PaymentId.description: ID of the payment associated with the payment credit. This field is a relationship field.

ReturnOrderId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReturnOrderId.description: ID of the return order associated with the payment credit. This field is a relationship field.

TotalApplied.description: Sum of all applied amounts from the payment credit line payment.

TotalUnapplied.description: Sum of all the unapplied amounts from the payment credit line payment.

special_access_rules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled. Users require the PaymentCredit and PaymentPlatform permission sets.
